The problem gives that the area of the square is 36.

When the area of the square is 36, the side length is 6.
The base of each gray triangle is on the top side or the right side of the square.
If the base is on the top side, then the height to the base is the side length of the square, 6.
If the base is on the right side, then the height to the base is also the side length of the square, 6.
The area of a triangle can be calculated using half of the product of the base and the height.
The total gray area is 3(a+b+c+d).
From the total gray area being 27, we can get 3(a+b+c+d)=27.
a+b+c+d=9。
